items.title: 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation
items.description: This study separates useful teacher corrections from the reliability of estimating their gradients from sampled tokens. It approximates a fixed-prefix signal-to-noise measure to select positions in student rollouts, alone or with usefulness scores; sparse supervision still requires generating and scoring complete trajectories in its implementation. 2026-09-21 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Code for 1% of Tokens Can Be Enough: On Gradient Estimation in On-Policy Distillation

items.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
items.description: On student-generated reasoning trajectories, this method gates each sampled token’s teacher–student log-probability signal by verified correctness, retaining updates that reinforce correct responses or suppress incorrect ones. Its group-relative variant uses the sign, not the magnitude, of the group advantage; the reported tests concern mathematical reasoning. 2026-08-25 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official repository for OPDVR: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward.

items.title: Beyond Teacher Likelihood: Group-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
items.description: GC-OPD separately normalizes verifier rewards and mean teacher–student token scores within student rollout groups. It distributes their signed difference across tokens while retaining the original distillation advantage; the correction vanishes when either group-level signal has negligible variation. 2026-08-19 Hybrid OPD Repository

items.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
items.description: TIDE diagnoses repetitive rollouts where local teacher agreement masks failure, then independently gates severe student-excess and student-deficit positions. It uses bounded Hellinger-shaped sampled-token suppression and teacher top-K cross-entropy to recover missing mass; its experiments concern mathematical reasoning with fixed external teachers. 2026-08-10 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Matching Supervision to the Student's Learning Capacity: A Unified Framework for On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.description: The method jointly adjusts soft token weights and how much reference context a privileged self-teacher sees while scoring student rollouts. A fixed learning-difficulty budget drives both controls through online updates; it is a capacity model, not a measured or automatically changing student-capacity limit. 2026-08-08 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: USD: Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation — jointly adapts soft token weighting and privileged-information strength under a shared learning-capacity budget.

items.title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
items.description: DAPD addresses privilege illusion in on-policy self-distillation with a trainable, self-conditioned bridge. It aligns reference and rollout behavior along inference-context and privileged-context paths in both guidance directions, while retaining the original privileged-teacher supervision rather than replacing it entirely. 2026-08-03 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation

items.title: When Top-K Misses the Decision: Tool-Call Drift in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.description: This study audits truncated teacher-logit support in routed tool-use distillation. High retained teacher mass can omit a tool-entry token important to student updates. Restoring student-relevant support improves agreement with full-vocabulary descent, but reduced over-calling is accompanied by lower call recall. 2026-07-08 Analysis Repository

items.title: PowerOPD: Stabilizing On-Policy Distillation with Bounded Power Transformation
items.description: PowerOPD replaces the detached teacher–student log-ratio coefficient on student-sampled tokens with a bounded, sign-preserving difference of powered token probabilities in a policy-gradient update. Its evaluations focus on mathematical reasoning and a limited set of teacher–student pairs. 2026-06-15 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: RLCSD: Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.description: RLCSD contrasts a self-teacher conditioned on correct versus incorrect same-query rollouts to reduce hint-induced style drift in sampled-token guidance. It uses that guidance to modulate a verifier-derived advantage in a clipped policy update, rather than directly minimizing contrastive reverse KL. 2026-06-10 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Source code of paper "RLCSD: Reinforcement Learning with Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation"

items.title: Reinforcement Learning from Rich Feedback with Distributional DAgger
items.description: DistIL queries a feedback-conditioned expert at prefixes visited by the student and minimizes forward cross-entropy, retaining a gradient term that credits earlier decisions for later disagreement. Its monotonic-improvement result concerns a better teacher and an idealized local update under stated assumptions. 2026-06-03 Interactive imitation Repository

items.title: Self-Distilled Policy Gradient
items.description: SDPG combines group-normalized verifier advantages with full-vocabulary reverse-KL self-distillation on student prefixes, using a detached, privileged-context branch of the same model. Distillation is gated to positive-advantage rollouts and accompanied by fixed-reference regularization; its policy-gradient identity applies locally at a sampled prefix. 2026-06-02 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: SDPG: Self-Distilled Policy Gradient

items.title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding
items.description: For vision-language OPD, this work separates language-prior matching from visual grounding and examines their gradient directions. Its update adds visual-target distillation to standard reverse KL, with selective language preservation; the visual signal depends on differences between the teacher’s image-conditioned and text-only predictions. 2026-05-30 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
items.description: A fixed-context diagnostic tests whether teacher–student disagreement predicts local KL reduction, separating teacher corrections on the student’s top candidates from largely off-support disagreement. The resulting selector applies reverse-KL distillation only at high-teachability positions on student rollouts; teachability measures local compatibility, not teacher reliability or answer-level success. 2026-05-26 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: The implementation of Teachability-Aware On-Policy Distillation (TA-OPD), the method introduced in Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation.

items.title: When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable? Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
items.description: PW-OPSD increases position weights on clipped forward-KL supervision from a privileged-answer self-teacher and averages losses per sequence. Its reliability diagnostic concerns ambiguous candidate tokens on correct reasoning traces; the reported method changes both weighting and aggregation, limiting attribution to weighting alone. 2026-05-20 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [NeurIPS 2026] The official implementation of our preprint paper "When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable? Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning"

items.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information
items.description: For student-sampled reasoning trajectories, this method adds a self-teacher signal to a verifiable-reward policy update, ascending Jensen–Shannon divergence to favor deliberative tokens disfavored by solution-conditioned predictions. Teacher-entropy gating suspends that term when its signal degrades; the induced token advantage is capped only on one side. 2026-05-12 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information

items.title: KL for a KL: On-Policy Distillation with Control Variate Baseline
items.description: vOPD subtracts a detached, action-independent estimate of the per-token negative reverse KL as a baseline for the sampled-token policy-gradient update. Its top-k variant approximates the baseline rather than truncating the distillation objective; the study evaluates token-level reasoning distillation, not sequence-level objectives. 2026-05-08 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Explain in Your Own Words: Improving Reasoning via Token-Selective Dual Knowledge Distillation
items.description: TSD-KD trains on student-generated reasoning using teacher rankings of student-proposed token candidates in an early response segment, alongside distribution matching gated by the student–teacher uncertainty gap and selective entropy minimization. The ranking loss supplies preferences, not full-distribution matching. 2026-02-25 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Explain in Your Own Words: Improving Reasoning via Token-Selective Dual Knowledge Distillation, The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2026, Accepted

items.title: Learning beyond Teacher: Generalized On-Policy Distillation with Reward Extrapolation
items.description: Generalized on-policy distillation scores student-generated trajectories with a teacher-to-reference log-probability ratio, scales that implicit reward, and penalizes divergence from the reference. Its extrapolation variants are studied in math and code; using a teacher’s pre-RL checkpoint as the reference requires access to that checkpoint. 2026-02-12 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official repository for the paper "Learning beyond Teacher: Generalized On-Policy Distillation with Reward Extrapolation"

items.title: Distillation of Large Language Models via Concrete Score Matching
items.description: Concrete Score Distillation matches weighted teacher–student logit differences across vocabulary pairs, allowing additive logit shifts. Factorized weights make gradient computation linear in vocabulary size. The objective requires a shared vocabulary and can complement on-policy training without itself requiring student rollouts. 2025-09-30 Offline comparator Repository

repo_info.description: Official repo for Distillation of Large Language Models via Concrete Score Matching  (ICLR 26)

items.title: DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs
items.description: DistiLLM-2 applies skewed forward divergence to teacher-generated responses and skewed reverse divergence to student-generated responses, while adapting the skew and loss balance during training. Student responses are generated in batches before each epoch, rather than freshly for every update. 2025-03-10 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official PyTorch implementation of DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs (ICML 2025 Oral)

items.title: AlignDistil: Token-Level Language Model Alignment as Adaptive Policy Distillation
items.description: AlignDistil constructs a token-level target by extrapolating logits from normal and reverse preference-trained models, with token-specific weights based on their distributional difference. It matches this target on student-sampled prefixes, but also provides an off-policy loss on fixed responses. 2025-03-04 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Code for ACL 2025 Paper "AlignDistil: Token-Level Language Model Alignment as Adaptive Policy Distillation"

items.title: DistiLLM: Towards Streamlined Distillation for Large Language Models
items.description: DistiLLM combines skewed token-distribution matching with an adaptive schedule that draws from fixed data or a replay buffer of student-generated responses. Because buffered responses are reused after collection, its data strategy is partly off-policy rather than continuously fresh student rollout. 2024-02-06 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official PyTorch implementation of DistiLLM: Towards Streamlined Distillation for Large Language Models (ICML 2024)

items.title: MiniLLM: On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
items.description: MiniLLM targets sequence-level reverse KL using student-generated responses and teacher probabilities. Its update separates an immediate full-vocabulary term from estimated future effects, with teacher-mixed sampling and other stabilizers; its reported evaluation centers on instruction following, not a general rule favoring reverse KL. 2023-06-14 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: General technology for enabling AI capabilities w/ LLMs and MLLMs

items.title: Objectives and update rules
LastOPD: Taming Collapse in Latent On-Policy Distillation
items.description: LastOPD aligns the student’s final pre-head representation with the teacher’s on student-generated responses, then fades that latent loss into token-level distillation. The crossfade is motivated by observed collapse under continued latent supervision in the tested cross-size model pairs. 2026-09-23 Hybrid OPD Repository

items.title: Counterfactual Constraint-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
items.description: CC-OPD generates student responses under all constraints while a frozen teacher rescores the same tokens with each constraint removed in turn. Summed, clipped likelihood shifts shape the distillation reward; teacher scoring grows with the number of constraints, without requiring additional student rollouts. 2026-09-23 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Counterfactual Constraint-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following

items.title: OPD-Aha: From Linguistic Momentum to Visual Reflection in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
items.description: The method contrasts one privileged-vision teacher's predictions with a real image and a visual null under the same student-generated prefix, then distills a reconstructed target on that rollout. It addresses erroneous prefixes that can obscure visual correction; reflection tokens are an observed effect, not an explicit target. 2026-09-15 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official implementation of OPD-Aha for fine-grained visual perception and multimodal reasoning

items.title: Learn from Whoever Is Right: Answer-Verified Multi-Teacher Distillation for Multi-Domain LLMs
items.description: MT-SDPO uses correct student peers as anchors and admits frozen teachers whose cached answers pass verification. Sanitized critiques condition a privileged moving-average self-teacher that supervises student tokens. The answer check does not certify subsequent critiques; evaluation uses multiple-choice science questions. 2026-09-02 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Learn from Whoever Is Right: Answer-Verified Multi-Teacher Distillation for Multi-Domain LLMs

items.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
items.description: OPD-V compares how zoomed and masked image views score tokens from the student’s original-image rollout. Positive score margins select and weight tokens for Jensen–Shannon matching to the zoomed-view self-teacher; training requires a task-relevant zoomed view from the data. 2026-08-05 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation
items.description: W2S-OPD forms a proxy teacher by adding the logit difference between weaker positive and negative sources to a frozen copy of the student’s base model, then distills it on student-generated rollouts. The tested contrasts and evaluations concern mathematical reasoning and code generation. 2026-07-28 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation

items.title: dOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
items.description: For diffusion language models, dOPSD matches predictions at masked positions in a student decoding state to stop-gradient predictions from later states of the same trajectory. Its reported training keeps only final-answer-correct rollouts; the teacher’s extra context does not come from a reference solution. 2026-07-05 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Rethinking Reward Supervision: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation
items.description: This two-stage self-distillation pipeline first learns question-specific rubrics, then conditions a privileged teacher on them to guide the student at its own generated prefixes. The reasoner uses token-level forward KL rather than a scalar rubric reward; evaluation emphasizes scientific reasoning. 2026-06-17 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Breaking the Tokenizer Barrier: On-Policy Distillation across Model Families
items.description: Cross-tokenizer OPD aligns student rollouts and teacher retokenizations into minimal matching text chunks, then allocates teacher chunk log-likelihood across student tokens using their prior log-probabilities. The resulting advantages drive clipped policy updates; supervision relies on aligned text chunks rather than shared vocabulary coordinates. 2026-06-08 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Teaching the Way, Not the Answer: Privileged Tutoring Distillation for Multimodal Policy Optimization
items.description: For multimodal reasoning with verifiable rewards, a frozen, hint-conditioned self-teacher guides failed student rollouts through token-distribution matching while the student sees only the original question. Spatial and intermediate reasoning hints are prepared offline using answers, but are intended not to reveal them. 2026-06-05 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: The source code of PTD-PO

items.title: Data-Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Models via On-Policy Distillation
items.description: A converted diffusion student samples its own reverse-denoising trajectory, then matches the frozen source autoregressive model’s token distributions at masked positions using causal prefixes from the completed student sequence. This addresses diffusion inference states, not ordinary autoregressive prefixes or agent turns. 2026-06-04 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Skill-Conditioned Gated Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
items.description: The student samples from a plain problem prompt while skill-and-mistake-conditioned self-teachers score that same rollout. Verifier outcomes determine whether each teacher’s support should be followed, reversed, or ignored; a gated sampled-token loss limits weak and extreme disagreements rather than assuming retrieved skills are trustworthy. 2026-05-27 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [EMNLP 2026] SGSD: Skill-Conditioned Gated Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning

items.title: Beyond Imitation: Reflective On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
items.description: A self-reflector compares incorrect on-policy rollouts with successful ones to supply a corrective idea and locate the first error. The idea conditions a self-teacher, while distillation skips the valid prefix; correct rollouts and unmatched error quotes receive full-response supervision. 2026-05-27 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: AVSD: Adaptive-View Self-Distillation by Balancing Consensus and Teacher-Specific Privileged Signals
items.description: AVSD combines privileged views of the same model on student-generated trajectories. A geometric consensus anchors the target, while gated view-specific residuals adjust it; the student learns through reverse KL. Evaluation covers mathematical and code reasoning, with broader agent applications left untested. 2026-05-20 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: It Takes Two: Complementary Self-Distillation for Contextual Integrity in LLMs
items.description: On student-generated responses, two feedback-conditioned self-teachers separately guide task-relevant retention and minimal disclosure through weighted token-level reverse KL, inducing a product-of-experts target. The construction uses explicit attribute partitions and synthetic disclosure decisions, and evaluation focuses on final responses. 2026-05-18 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Vision-OPD: Learning to See Fine Details for Multimodal LLMs via On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.description: A full-image student generates responses while a crop-conditioned self-teacher scores the same prefixes, and training minimizes token-level Jensen–Shannon divergence through the student alone. The method requires paired evidence-centered crops and fine-grained questions prepared for training, rather than discovering target regions at inference. 2026-05-18 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Vision-OPD is a regional-to-global on-policy self-distillation framework that transfers a model's own privileged crop-conditioned perception to its full-image policy, enabling fine-grained visual understanding in a single forward pass without external teachers, labels, or verifiers.

items.title: Learning with Rare Success but Rich Feedback via Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation
items.description: After a student rollout fails, RESD uses environmental feedback to generate a retrospective diagnosis and curate reusable lessons in a persistent playbook. That context guides a self-teacher’s token-level supervision on student rollouts, including when successful demonstrations are unavailable; it requires informative feedback. 2026-05-12 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [arXiv 2026] Learning from Rare Success and Rich Feedback via Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation

items.title: Multi-Rollout On-Policy Distillation via Peer Successes and Failures
items.description: For each prompt, the student generates multiple rollouts that a verifier divides into successes and failures. A teacher uses other rollouts from the group to supervise each target rollout through token-level divergence; the approach depends on reliable success labels and available peers. 2026-05-12 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Crosslingual On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning
items.description: COPSD trains on reasoning generated from low-resource-language problems, using a frozen self-teacher with privileged English translations and reference solutions. Experiments use full-vocabulary reverse KL on the same student prefixes; only the student is updated, and training requires English reference solutions. 2026-05-10 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Crosslingual On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning

items.title: Training with Harnesses: On-Policy Harness Self-Distillation for Complex Reasoning
items.description: OPHSD trains on direct student rollouts while a teacher conditioned on a harness-produced terminal context supplies distillation targets. The harness can use privileged training information; evidence that the student works without it comes from the tested draft–verify and plan–solve settings, not arbitrary workflows. 2026-05-09 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [NeurlPS 2026] Training with Harnesses: On-Policy Harness Self-Distillation for Complex Reasoning

items.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
items.description: SimCT compares teacher and student on shared tokens plus short text continuations jointly expressible under different tokenizers, using student-generated prefixes and retaining the reverse-KL OPD loss. Its normalized candidate scores are not a probability-preserving mapping of all continuations. 2026-05-08 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: UniSD: Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
items.description: On student-generated completions, UniSD studies reliability weighting across self-derived teacher views alongside EMA targets, token-level distribution matching, contrastive learning, representation matching, and divergence clipping. Its agreement views share one teacher model and require additional scoring rather than external verification. 2026-05-07 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official implementation for "Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models" (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06597).

items.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
items.description: MAD-OPD has teachers debate a student-visited state, then score the sampled student action with privileged debate context. Confidence-weighted token losses use symmetric Jensen–Shannon divergence for agent tasks and reverse KL for code; training depends on teacher deliberation and confidence estimates. 2026-05-02 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official code for "Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation   via Multi-Agent Debate" (arXiv:2605.01347).

items.title: π-Play: Multi-Agent Self-Play via Privileged Self-Distillation without External Data
items.description: In search-agent self-play, an examiner constructs questions and their search paths; a path-conditioned teacher supervises unprivileged student rollouts while the student also learns from outcome rewards. The teacher tracks the student by moving average, and evaluation is limited to search tasks. 2026-04-15 Hybrid OPD Repository

items.title: Self-Distillation Zero: Self-Revision Turns Binary Rewards into Dense Supervision
items.description: After training on verified self-revisions, SD-Zero samples generator responses and uses a reviser conditioned on each response and its binary reward to provide token-level targets. The reviser is frozen between synchronizations; the method requires a binary verifier and successful revision traces. 2026-04-13 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: CRISP: Compressed Reasoning via Iterative Self-Policy Distillation
items.description: This reasoning-compression method scores student-generated continuations with a self-teacher given a conciseness instruction, then minimizes token-level reverse KL with periodic teacher refreshes. The teacher receives no ground-truth solution, and excessive compression can hurt harder problems. 2026-03-05 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation
items.description: SDPO samples current-policy attempts, then conditions that policy on feedback to re-evaluate those attempts as a self-teacher and distills its next-token distributions into the student. When only scalar outcomes are available, successful attempts can supply feedback; the mechanism relies on the model’s ability to use that context. 2026-01-28 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation (SDPO)

items.title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
items.description: OPSD compares next-token distributions on a problem-only student’s own rollouts with those of the same model given a reference solution, updating only the student side. Its reasoning experiments use a frozen initial teacher target and show weaker results at the smallest tested scale. 2026-01-26 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Stable On-Policy Distillation through Adaptive Target Reformulation
items.description: Veto forms a product target from teacher probabilities and a detached student contribution. Its fixed-coefficient comparison tests target reweighting independently of annealing; the paper's parameter-gradient stability guarantee is not established by that empirical result. 2026-01-12 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [ACL 2026 findings] Official Implementation of "Stable On-Policy Distillation through Adaptive Target Reformulation"

items.title: A Dual-Space Framework for General Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
items.description: DSKD projects teacher and student hidden states into each other’s representation spaces so distributions compared in each space share a prediction head; it also trains one projector with cross-entropy. It supports student-generated training, but cross-tokenizer distillation uses only exactly aligned token positions. 2025-04-15 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: The official implementation of the paper "A Dual-Space Framework for General Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models".

items.title: PromptKD: Distilling Student-Friendly Knowledge for Generative Language Models via Prompt Tuning
items.description: On student-generated responses, PromptKD alternates student-guided tuning of soft teacher prompts with reverse-KL updates of the student toward the prompted teacher. Teacher weights stay fixed, while an early, decaying regularizer limits how far the prompted teacher departs from its unprompted distribution. 2024-02-20 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: An official implementation of "PromptKD: Distilling Student-Friendly Knowledge for Generative Language Models via Prompt Tuning" (EMNLP 2024 Findings) in PyTorch.

items.title: Teacher and supervision construction
Sequential Beats Joint: On the Interplay between On-Policy Distillation and RLVR
items.description: This study compares distillation followed by verifier-reward reinforcement learning with joint updates. On logic and mathematics tasks, reverse-KL distillation expands coverage of teacher-supported solutions and subsequent reinforcement learning sharpens that support; this explanation is based on the evaluated training settings. 2026-09-03 Hybrid OPD Repository

items.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
items.description: Relay-OPD detects when the teacher favors a reflection token absent from the student’s leading options, then inserts short, budgeted teacher continuations into student rollouts. The student resumes when the budget permits, and distillation uses the resulting mixed trajectories; evaluation focuses on mathematical reasoning. 2026-07-28 Hybrid OPD Repository

items.title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
items.description: ShortOPD recovers a structurally pruned student by distilling its pre-pruning self on student-generated rollouts. A controller shortens future rollout horizons when terminal repetition is high and grows them when clean rollouts hit the limit; detected suffixes do not mask the current batch’s loss. 2026-07-14 Direct OPD Repository 1Repository 2

repo_info.description: Vision-OPD is a regional-to-global on-policy self-distillation framework that transfers a model's own privileged crop-conditioned perception to its full-image policy, enabling fine-grained visual understanding in a single forward pass without external teachers, labels, or verifiers.

items.title: AsyncOPD: How Stale Can On-Policy Distillation Be?
items.description: AsyncOPD studies stale student rollouts when teacher scores are cached for limited token sets, then overlaps rollout, teacher scoring and learning. For reverse-KL updates it refreshes the student-dependent advantage and averages importance-weighted local token samples; this addresses sampled actions at fixed prefixes, not stale prefixes. 2026-06-23 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [NeurIPS 2026] AsyncOPD: How Stale Can On-Policy Distillation Be?

items.title: Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation
items.description: FiRe-OPD discards student-generated trajectories with low average teacher likelihood, then softly reweights token updates in retained trajectories using teacher confidence and student uncertainty. Its PPO-style clipped update uses teacher–old-policy token log-likelihood differences; the filtering does not avoid generating the discarded trajectories. 2026-06-01 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: Uni-OPD: Unifying On-Policy Distillation with a Dual-Perspective Recipe
items.description: Uni-OPD trains on student rollouts, balances prompt difficulty and correct versus incorrect outcomes, then calibrates teacher–student log-probability returns against correctness before policy-gradient updates. Outcome labels are part of the update, so this is not solely token-level teacher matching. 2026-05-05 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Uni-OPD: Unifying On-Policy Distillation with a Dual-Perspective Recipe

items.title: TIP: Token Importance in On-Policy Distillation
items.description: TIP studies which positions in student-generated rollouts warrant distillation, selecting tokens using student entropy and teacher–student disagreement. Entropy alone misses confident disagreements; the combined selector retains them, but disagreement does not establish that the teacher’s preferred continuation is correct. 2026-04-15 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: On Policy Distillation Build on top of Verl

items.title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation
items.description: Lightning OPD reuses fixed rollouts from a supervised-fine-tuned reference and cached teacher log-probabilities, updating the student without live teacher scoring. Its offline approximation uses the same teacher for fine-tuning data and scoring; rollouts are not refreshed from the evolving student. 2026-04-14 Offline comparator Repository

items.title: SCOPE: Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement with Dual-Path Adaptive Weighting
items.description: This method routes verified student rollouts by correctness: incorrect responses receive teacher-perplexity-weighted token distillation, while correct responses receive student-perplexity-weighted likelihood training. Weights are normalized within each prompt group; the reported diversity evidence comes from sampled mathematical reasoning evaluations, not a general guarantee against collapse. 2026-04-12 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: SCOPE: Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement with Dual-Path Adaptive Weighting

items.title: Self-Play Fine-Tuning Converts Weak Language Models to Strong Language Models
items.description: SPIN repeatedly generates responses from a previous version of a supervised fine-tuned model and trains the next version to favor existing human demonstrations over those responses. Its comparison target is a fixed demonstration dataset, not a teacher’s token distributions on current student rollouts. 2024-01-02 Background Repository

repo_info.description: The official implementation of Self-Play Fine-Tuning (SPIN)

items.title: Data and training dynamics
Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.description: On student-generated multi-turn interactions, this method scores realized tokens with and without their turn’s post-action outcome, then uses signed probability gaps to guide updates. It normalizes gap magnitudes across turns to allocate dense hindsight feedback alongside outcome-based GRPO; evaluation covers two interactive environments. 2026-08-07 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official code for Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning.

items.title: MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents
items.description: For compact-memory agents, this method reconstructs each student invocation’s tokens, positions and causal visibility before a frozen teacher scores sampled actions, avoiding supervision under an unvisited flattened-history state. It combines teacher distribution matching with task-reward PPO; end-to-end training is tested on retrieval tasks. 2026-08-07 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official PyTorch implementation of the paper "MemOPD: On-Policy Distillation through Memory State Alignment for Long-Horizon Agents" (MemOPD).

items.title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
items.description: FutureBridge-OPD selects a student-controlled turn with weak sampled teacher support, substitutes a teacher action, and compares paired student continuations before retaining the bridge for distillation. This validation uses future teacher-preferred-token density, not task reward, and builds on a curriculum initialized from successful trajectories. 2026-08-03 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official code for FutureBridge-OPD

items.title: DASH-OPD: Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for On-Policy Distillation
items.description: DASH-OPD accumulates drift and recovery evidence to alternate student and teacher execution, applying different losses to each source. Updated controls isolate recovery and evidence accumulation with matched tuning budgets. Fewer switches and teacher turns are measured execution properties, not a demonstrated end-to-end speedup. 2026-07-31 Hybrid OPD Repository

items.title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation
items.description: UCOB collects skill-conditioned and unconditioned on-policy agent rollouts, compares return-to-go at matched task and anchor states, and distills the higher-return view’s stopped token distribution into the other alongside RL. The teacher direction can reverse; comparisons depend on matching states. 2026-06-28 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Official Implementation of UCOB: Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation for Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills.

items.title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
items.description: PF-OPSD trains a student to invoke, check, and use world-model simulations for visual future prediction. A privileged evaluator scores student trajectories using true future videos and answers; those scores supervise decisions and text, while the evaluator and true futures remain unavailable at deployment. 2026-06-02 Teacher-mediated RL Repository

repo_info.description: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning

items.title: CoMAP: Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents
items.description: COMAP uses a textual world model’s predicted next state to help an agent decide whether to revise a draft action. Executed transitions then train the world model with observed-state supervision and on-policy self-distillation from a privileged teacher mode; the setting assumes text-representable states and outcomes. 2026-06-01 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [EMNLP main 2026]Co-Evolving World Models and Agent Policies for LLM Agents

items.title: HINT-SD: Targeted Hindsight Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
items.description: HINT-SD analyzes failed agent rollouts to identify relevant actions and generate local corrections. A hindsight-conditioned self-teacher supervises the student through reverse token KL only at selected action spans; effectiveness depends on feedback that identifies actionable failures. 2026-05-18 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [EMNLP Findings 2026] HINT-SD: Targeted Hindsight Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents

items.title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents
items.description: SOD addresses tool-call errors that shift later reasoning contexts by weighting each step’s sampled-token teacher–student log-likelihood signal according to changes in their discrepancy, alongside outcome-based reinforcement learning. Tool observations are excluded from the distillation loss; the discrepancy score is a proxy, not full token KL. 2026-05-08 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: PyTorch-based open-source code for paper "SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents"

items.title: TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents
items.description: TCOD addresses rising divergence across turns in interactive distillation by gradually extending the student’s training horizon. One variant lengthens student-generated prefixes; another starts student suffixes after successful teacher-executed prefixes, which require pre-collected trajectories and do not contribute gradients. 2026-04-27 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: [COLM 2026]TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents

items.title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking
items.description: OpenClaw-RL turns subsequent interaction feedback into hints for a privileged self-teacher that scores the student’s original response prefixes. The updated report compares overlap-based hint selection with random hints and tests support and clipping choices. Its asynchronous agent results have task-specific training and evaluation limits. 2026-03-10 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: OpenClaw-RL: Train any agent simply by talking

items.title: Agentic and multi-turn distillation
ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
items.description: ACLArena examines forgetting and transfer across sequential agent post-training stages, comparing multi-teacher on-policy distillation with offline self-distillation and model merging. Its proposed retention recipe instead replays specialist trajectories and trains routed reinforcement-learning adapters; the reported study chiefly uses one backbone and a fixed stage order. 2026-09-21 Analysis Repository

items.title: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
items.description: This study traces some response-length inflation in sampled-token distillation to students and teachers preferring different tokens for the same stopping action. Aggregating equivalent termination tokens in the training signal mitigates that mismatch in single-turn math tests, but late-run inflation can remain. 2026-09-17 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Correcting termination mismatch in on-policy distillation to prevent length inflation.

items.title: Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training
items.description: The paper tests whether complete reasoning traces are needed, primarily by training on pre-collected traces with their middle spans removed while retaining both ends. Its OPD extension masks middle-position loss on student rollouts rather than shortening generation; the findings concern tested reasoning settings. 2026-09-07 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: EMNLP 2026 Findings

items.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
items.description: This study repeatedly distills on fresh student rollouts from a single query and compares semantic-cluster coverage of visited prefixes with full-data training. It finds broad early coverage but slower teacher alignment; cluster coverage does not measure every state's instructional value. 2026-09-03 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example

items.title: Privileged Solutions or Context-Induced Teacher Behavior? Dissecting On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.description: This diagnostic study replaces the target problem’s reference solution with another mathematics problem’s worked solution in the self-teacher’s context, while preserving student rollouts and the distillation objective. The results challenge a purely answer-transfer explanation but do not identify a unique causal mechanism. 2026-08-10 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: On-policy self-distillation using worked solutions from other problems.

items.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
items.description: In controlled multi-turn planning environments, this study compares on-policy teacher supervision with reward-based updates and examines sequential distillation from multiple teachers. Its findings depend on data quality, planning horizon, and shared patterns; mismatched procedural knowledge or conflicting patterns can impair transfer. 2026-07-27 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Agentic Long-Horizon Planning

items.title: Behavior Cloning is Not All You Need: The Optimality of On-Policy Distillation for Noisy Expert Feedback
items.description: This analysis asks why learner-state queries can outperform offline cloning when expert feedback is noisy. It derives an offline horizon barrier and studies interactive imitation through augmented-trajectory matching; its guarantees depend on a finite policy class and corruption assumptions, not on arbitrary OPD procedures. 2026-06-29 Analysis Repository

items.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
items.description: This analysis measures checkpoint updates after on-policy distillation, finding coordinate-sparse changes distributed across modules and numerically full-rank matrices with concentrated spectra. The visible changes favor low-magnitude, nonprincipal source coordinates; these are observations across studied model pairs, not a new training objective. 2026-06-11 Analysis Repository

items.title: Rethinking Continual Experience Internalization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
items.description: This study asks whether repeated internalization of experience-aware behavior sustains gains in web agents, comparing experience granularity, injection timing, and trajectory source. In its tested setting, filtered teacher trajectories provide more stable training than repeated distillation on student-induced states. 2026-06-03 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Official code for "Rethinking Continual Experience Internalization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents"

items.title: Learning to Foresee: Unveiling the Unlocking Efficiency of On-Policy Distillation
items.description: This parameter-dynamics study compares where on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning place updates and how early update subspaces align with final directions. An accompanying accelerator validates extrapolations of recent parameter displacements; its studied distillation typically uses a separate stronger teacher, not necessarily a self-teacher. 2026-05-12 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Repository for EffOPD. We are working on polishing the details.

items.title: The Illusion of Certainty: Decoupling Capability and Calibration in On-Policy Distillation
items.description: CaOPD examines how privileged-context self-teaching can transfer unjustified confidence alongside task behavior. It replaces verbalized confidence in the training completion and teacher context with a verifier-based success estimate from student rollouts, then distills on the revised completion; this requires parseable confidence and additional training rollouts. 2026-04-18 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: CaOPD: Calibration-Aware On-Policy Distillation

items.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
items.description: This study examines why distillation on student rollouts succeeds or fails in mathematical reasoning, linking gains to compatible reasoning patterns and teacher knowledge new to the student. It analyzes high-probability token overlap and tests cold starts and prompt selection, not universal success criteria. 2026-04-14 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe

items.title: Why Does Self-Distillation (Sometimes) Degrade the Reasoning Capability of LLMs?
items.description: This analysis tests why solution-conditioned self-distillation can shorten mathematical reasoning yet harm performance: richer teacher context suppresses expressed uncertainty that may help on unseen problems. Its evidence concerns the studied math settings and a limited set of English uncertainty markers. 2026-03-25 Analysis Repository

repo_info.description: Codebase for the work “Why Does Self-Distillation (Sometimes) Degrade the Reasoning Capability of LLMs?”

items.title: Mechanisms, failures, and evaluation
SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation
items.description: For indirect prompt-injection defense, this application samples student responses to attacked inputs and scores each token with a frozen initialization model given the corresponding clean input, using detached token advantages for policy updates. It assumes trusted instructions and untrusted data are distinguishable. 2026-08-21 Application / system report Repository

repo_info.description: [EMNLP'26 Main] SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation

items.title: Reducing the Safety Tax in LLM Safety Alignment with On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.description: For safety alignment, the student generates responses to harmful and benign prompts while a frozen copy conditioned on type-specific safety or helpfulness context supplies token-distribution targets. Context search uses teacher flip rate; the approach depends on privileged prompts eliciting safer behavior. 2026-05-14 Direct OPD Repository

items.title: HyperEyes: Dual-Grained Efficiency-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Parallel Multimodal Search Agents
items.description: HyperEyes trains a multimodal search agent with an adaptive trajectory-level reward for tool use and external-teacher token correction on failed student rollouts. Its parallel grounded-search action also changes; OPD is enabled for the smaller variant, so full-system results cannot isolate distillation. 2026-05-08 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: HyperEyes is a parallel multimodal search agent that fuses visual grounding and retrieval into a single atomic action, enabling concurrent search across multiple entities while treating inference efficiency as a first-class training objective.

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction via Self-Distillation
items.description: A pretrained autoregressive model learns to propose token blocks in one pass while a frozen copy scores the student’s own greedy proposals. The resulting predictor uses confidence-adaptive decoding; the conversion is evaluated on selected generation tasks rather than all text domains. 2026-02-05 Direct OPD Repository

repo_info.description: Source code to accompany research paper on training multi token prediction language models using self-distillation.

items.title: MiMo-V2-Flash Technical Report
items.description: The report uses multi-teacher on-policy distillation to consolidate domain-specialist capabilities, combining dense token-level teacher rewards with verifiable outcome rewards. This is one stage of a broader post-training pipeline, so the final model’s capabilities cannot be attributed to distillation alone. 2026-01-06 Hybrid OPD Repository

repo_info.description: MiMo-V2-Flash: Efficient Reasoning, Coding, and Agentic Foundation Model

items.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
items.description: The report describes a small-model compression pipeline that uses off-policy transfer from stronger models before on-policy distillation with teacher-logit guidance. It also describes separate supervised and reinforcement-learning stages for preparing larger models; its student-stage comparison does not account for preparing the stronger teacher. 2025-05-14 Application / system report Repository

repo_info.description: Qwen3 is the large language model series developed by Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud.

items.title: Applications and systems
On-Policy Distillation
items.description: Student-generated trajectories are scored using teacher log probabilities for sampled tokens, and a policy-gradient-style update uses the negative log-ratio as per-token feedback. This implementation uses immediate next-token credit, not full-vocabulary teacher distributions or future-token returns; the citation here supports sampled-token supervision. 2025-10-26 Background Repository

repo_info.description: Post-training with Tinker

items.title: Why Knowledge Distillation Works in Generative Models: A Minimal Working Explanation
items.description: This analysis asks how teacher selectivity changes a distilled generator’s balance between sample quality and distributional coverage. Gaussian-mixture simulations and language-model pretraining experiments find higher precision with lower recall when teacher samples become more selective; they do not test on-policy distillation or post-training. 2025-05-19 Background Repository

repo_info.description: Official code of Why Knowledge Distillation Works in Generative Models: A Minimal Working Explanation (NeurIPS 2025)

items.title: MiniPLM: Knowledge Distillation for Pre-Training Language Models
items.description: MiniPLM selects pre-training texts offline using the probability difference between a teacher and a small reference model, then trains students with ordinary next-token prediction on the selected corpus. Selection does not use current student rollouts or require teacher inference during student training. 2024-10-22 Background Repository

repo_info.description: [ICLR 2025] MiniPLM: Knowledge Distillation for Pre-Training Language Models

items.title: HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RLHF Framework
items.description: HybridFlow is an RLHF execution framework that centrally coordinates dependencies between distributed models while letting each model manage its own computation. It also reshards actor weights between generation and training; these systems mechanisms do not specify teacher targets for on-policy distillation. 2024-09-28 Background Repository

repo_info.description: verl/HybridFlow: A Flexible and Efficient RL Post-Training Framework

items.title: OpenRLHF: An Easy-to-use, Scalable and High-performance RLHF Framework
items.description: OpenRLHF is infrastructure for reinforcement-learning fine-tuning: it coordinates response generation, scoring, and learner updates across distributed engines, with asynchronous dataflow and separate generation and training roles. It does not itself define a teacher-distribution distillation objective or its synchronization policy. 2024-05-20 Background Repository

repo_info.description: An Easy-to-use, Scalable and High-performance Agentic RL Framework based on Ray (PPO & DAPO & REINFORCE++ &  VLM & TIS & vLLM & Ray & Async  RL)

items.title: Rethinking Kullback-Leibler Divergence in Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
items.description: AKL weights forward and reverse token KL according to teacher–student gaps in the distribution’s head and tail, motivated by their different early training behavior. The study uses instruction-response training data and does not establish distillation on student-generated prefixes. 2024-04-03 Background Repository

items.title: A Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
items.description: This survey organizes language-model knowledge distillation by algorithms, transferred skills, and domain-specific uses, including data augmentation and self-generated knowledge. It synthesizes prior work rather than introducing a training rule or establishing which surveyed methods use student-generated prefixes. 2024-02-20 Background Repository

repo_info.description: This repository collects papers for "A Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models". We break down KD into Knowledge Elicitation and Distillation Algorithms, and explore the Skill & Vertical Distillation of LLMs.

items.title: TensorRT-LLM: High-Performance Inference Framework for Large Language Models
items.description: TensorRT LLM accelerates inference on NVIDIA GPUs through specialized kernels, runtime optimizations, and Python interfaces for deploying language models. It provides inference infrastructure relevant to generation workloads; the framework itself does not define an on-policy distillation objective. 2024 Background Repository

repo_info.description: TensorRT LLM provides users with an easy-to-use Python API to define Large Language Models (LLMs) and supports state-of-the-art optimizations to perform inference efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs. TensorRT LLM also contains components to create Python and C++ runtimes that orchestrate the inference execution in a performant way.

items.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
items.description: PagedAttention stores attention key–value caches in fixed-size blocks that need not occupy contiguous memory, allowing an LLM serving engine to allocate and share cache space across sequences. It addresses generation-time memory management, not teacher supervision or a distillation update. 2023-09-12 Background Repository

repo_info.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs

items.title: Distilling Step-by-Step! Outperforming Larger Language Models with Less Training Data and Smaller Model Sizes
items.description: A teacher generates labels and natural-language rationales for task examples; a smaller model learns separate label-prediction and rationale-generation tasks from those outputs. Training uses collected teacher responses rather than student-visited prefixes, and the student can predict labels without requesting a rationale at test time. 2023-05-03 Background Repository

items.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
items.description: This evaluation framework organizes language-model use cases and metrics, then benchmarks models across shared scenarios using multiple measures beyond accuracy. Its implemented coverage is selective, and its standardized prompting evaluations are not a training or on-policy distillation method. 2022-11-16 Background Repository

repo_info.description: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models (HELM) is an open source Python framework created by the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM) at Stanford for holistic, reproducible and transparent evaluation of foundation models, including large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models.

items.title: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation
items.description: For neural machine translation, sequence-level distillation trains a student on teacher beam-search outputs; an alternative selects a beam candidate close to the reference translation. These are teacher-generated training targets, not trajectories sampled from the student during learning. 2016-06-25 Background Repository 1Repository 2

repo_info.description: Neural Machine Translation on Android
